basic_details.job_title: NAM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Account Assistant, Programme Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The State Programme Management Unit of National Ayush Mission (NAM), Assam has invited online applications for three contractual posts in mission mode: Consultant - HR (₹50,000 per month), Account Assistant (₹22,000) and Programme Assistant (₹20,000), one vacancy each, all unreserved. Applications go through the NHM, Assam website https://nhm.assam.gov.in until 05:00 PM on 27 November 2026. The advertisement is numbered 771414/I/1846605/2026 and dated 12 November 2026, and no application fee is required.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is up to 40 years as on 01-01-2026 for all three posts. Age is calculated from the Matriculation / HSLC Admit Card or Pass Certificate issued by a recognized Board/Council; no other document is accepted instead. | Category Maximum age (years) Open Category (UR) 40 OBC/MOBC 43 (relaxation 3 years) SC/ST(P)/ST(H) 45 (relaxation 5 years) PwD 50 (relaxation 10 years) | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Open the NHM, Assam website https://nhm.assam.gov.in, where candidates have to apply online.

Fill the online application form for the post applied for. The form is available on the official websites of National Ayush Mission, Assam and National Health Mission, Assam until 05:00 PM on 27 November 2026.
Upload the supporting documents listed below.
Submit the application. No correction claims are entertained after submission.
Educational qualification certificates from Matriculation to highest qualification.
Registration certificate for Ayush doctors from Assam State Council/Board.
Other relevant documents, if applicable, against the post applied for.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will be rejected without any prior information. Claims for any correction will not be entertained after the online application is submitted. The authority reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reasons. Application fee: no fee is required to be paid.

content_sections.heading: NAM Assam Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the stages of the selection process; these will be notified later on the official websites.

rows.details: National Ayush Mission, Assam (State Programme Management Unit)
Consultant - HR; Account Assistant; Programme Assistant
Up to 40 years as on 01-01-2026 (higher for reserved categories)
No fee is required to be paid

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists three vacancies, one for each post, all in the General/UR category. The other category columns carry dashes in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints each post's qualification, experience and skills in one column. Wording such as "desirable" and "advantage" is kept as printed. Exposure in social sector schemes/missions of Govt. at National, State and District. Experience in HR functions in management organizations is desirable. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to complete multiple tasks and should be a team player. Knowledge of governmental recruitment, filling process and procedure in Human Resource Management will be an advantage. Desirable knowledge of law related to human resource. Computer proficiency in MS-Office, MS-Word, Power Point and advanced Excel skills. Exposure in social sector schemes/missions of Govt. at national, state and district. Computer proficiency in MS Office and Tally. Knowledge of GFR, 2017 is desirable. Knowledge of PFMS, TDS, TCS matters under Income Tax and GST. Knowledge of accounting standards and corporate laws. Exposure in social sector schemes/missions of Govt. at national, state and district. MS Office; excellent verbal and written communication skills in English are essential. The upper age limit is up to 40 years as on 01-01-2026 for all three posts. Age is calculated from the Matriculation / HSLC Admit Card or Pass Certificate issued by a recognized Board/Council; no other document is accepted instead. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification_required: MBA(HR)/PGDBM(HR), minimum two years duration, from recognized university / institution
Post Graduate/Graduate in any discipline with one year Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Application (PGDCA) from Govt. recognize institute

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The three posts are engagements on a contractual basis. Remuneration is ₹50,000.00 per month for Consultant - HR, ₹22,000.00 for Account Assistant and ₹20,000.00 for Programme Assistant. The notice says detailed terms and conditions and other criteria of the recruitment process will be published in due course on https://ayush.assam.gov.in and https://nhm.assam.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM Assam Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the NHM, Assam website https://nhm.assam.gov.in , where candidates have to apply online. Fill the online application form for the post applied for. The form is available on the official websites of National Ayush Mission, Assam and National Health Mission, Assam until 05:00 PM on 27 November 2026. Upload the supporting documents listed below. Submit the application. No correction claims are entertained after submission. Educational qualification certificates from Matriculation to highest qualification. Experience certificate. Caste certificate. Registration certificate for Ayush doctors from Assam State Council/Board. Computer certificate. Other relevant documents, if applicable, against the post applied for.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process will be notified on the official website of National Ayush Mission, Assam ( https://ayush.assam.gov.in ) and on https://nhm.assam.gov.in in due course, along with the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates. No separate individual call letter for an interview or selection test will be sent, so candidates should keep visiting the websites. Merely having the requisite qualification and experience does not make an applicant eligible for short listing.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will be rejected without any prior information. Claims for any correction will not be entertained after the online application is submitted. The authority reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reasons. Application fee: no fee is required to be paid.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NAM Assam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one each for Consultant - HR, Account Assistant and Programme Assistant, all in the General/UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application form is available until 05:00 PM on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Consultant - HR?
faq.answer: MBA(HR)/PGDBM(HR) of minimum two years duration from a recognized university or institution, with minimum 5 years' experience in relevant fields and exposure in social sector schemes/missions of Govt.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Account Assistant and Programme Assistant?
faq.answer: Account Assistant needs a B.Com passed from a recognized university/institution. Programme Assistant needs a Post Graduate/Graduate degree in any discipline with one year PGDCA from a Govt. recognize institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Up to 40 years as on 01-01-2026. The maximum is 43 years for OBC/MOBC, 45 years for SC/ST(P)/ST(H) and 50 years for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice says no fee is required to be paid.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Consultant - HR gets ₹50,000.00 per month, Account Assistant ₹22,000.00 and Programme Assistant ₹20,000.00.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online on the NHM, Assam website https://nhm.assam.gov.in and upload the supporting documents, including educational certificates from Matriculation to the highest qualification and the experience certificate.

faq.question: Q9. Will an individual call letter be sent for the interview or test?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no separate individual call letter will be sent; the selection process and shortlist will be notified on https://ayush.assam.gov.in and https://nhm.assam.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent posts?
faq.answer: No. The notice invites applications for engagement on a contractual basis in mission mode.
